translations.web: We have heard its report. Our hands become feeble. Anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.
translations.bsb: We have heard the report; our hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped us, pain like that of a woman in labor.
translations.kjv: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
translations.asv: We have heard the report thereof; our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
